authorization: User requested year/month concentration, industry/stock contribution, same-date industry controls
original: Original E1 expanding monthly first weekly signal Q5, main cost, suspend_flat; not alpha_economics constrained S1

attribution.stock_pnl: change in close marked stock value minus net executed trade cash; prior NAV denominator
attribution.opportunity_charge: Subtract previous-close stock weight times actual H00300 close-to-close return; cash charged previous cash weight, fees separate; opening index value never fabricated
attribution.wealth_link: Sum daily linked contributions gives log relative wealth. Multiply all contributions by 100*(terminal portfolio NAV-terminal benchmark NAV)/log(relative NAV) to attribute terminal wealth difference per initial100yuan; single common scale for all months/years/stocks
attribution.industry: Historical L1 interval at previous market close, UNKNOWN explicit. New stock PnL assigned same previous-close industry. Industry totals locate the account contribution; NOT allocation/selection attribution relative to true index constituent weights
attribution.periods: Calendar years and months, initial build included; annual/month raw return differences are not additive; linked wealth contributions are additive across all periods
attribution.concentration: Report top3 months, top5/10 stocks and top3 industries with shares of signed total; no pruning to create strategy

controls.EW_ALL: All historical members equalweight, exact original dates; verify against existing same-period EW ledger
controls.EW_SCORED: Original E1 finite-score contemporaneous members equalweight; no new 13-style complete-case filter
controls.INDUSTRY: Original E1 target industry capital fractions, spread equally within each historical industry over SAME finite-score member pool; same initial1 cash, dates, costs, gates and mark rules; not same number of holdings
controls.E1_REPLAY: Original target weights exactly; require original NAV and order replication
controls.chain: Index -> EW_ALL -> EW_SCORED -> INDUSTRY -> original E1. Linked log increments and CAGR differences telescope exactly on common available interval
controls.interpretation: EW_ALL/index includes equalweight, investable-universe and benchmark-account basis effects. INDUSTRY/EW_SCORED is target-industry-budget/path effect. E1/INDUSTRY includes within-industry selection, concentration, drift and execution, not pure causal stock alpha
controls.risk: Target industry fractions identical; realized post-fill industry mismatch, cash, fees and holdings count disclosed; normalized proportions equal, evolving absolute NAV budgets may differ
controls.missing: Never fill held unknown values or invent corporate-action terminal payoffs. If control stops before primary end, reduce common bridge endpoint and keep original full-period attribution separately

statistics: Bridge contrasts descriptive paired daily means, 65 trading-day circular blocks, 2000 draws, seed20261117; intervals for annual mean daily return difference, not CAGR gap; no new confirmatory family
no_change: No model retraining, score changes, trading-date search, tolerance optimization, original artifact overwrite, deployment or publishing
